30: There, this is the reason, both of them make an oath and take: Because the storekeeper can say to the homeowner, "I carried out your agency that you ordered me and gave the money to your worker."
What [business] do I have with the hired laborer to challenge [his claim].

He is not trustworthy to me: I do not trust him with an oath; I say that he is evil. And I do not have to trust a person with an oath against my will, unless I trusted him from the beginning, to deposit [something] with him or to make a stipulation with him.
You trusted him: And you are the one who fouled up, so I should not have to lose through your fouling up, such that my money should remain until Eliyahu comes.
